title: selliguea elliptica
intro: Selliguea elliptica, commonly known as Sensitive Fern or Polypodium pellucidum, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a medicinal herb native to the tropical regions of Asia and Africa, and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea elliptica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are believed to work by modulating the immune system and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Selliguea elliptica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
